identity.name: FUEL
identity.mission: A bold performance-nutrition cafe brand. Sand canvas, ink structure, electric-lime signature. Goal-first ordering, honest macros, big food.
core_principles: Fuel, not punishment: eating for your goal should feel powerful and clean.
Big & confident: massive Anton display type, generous whitespace.
One signature color: electric lime used sparingly for energy and action.
Proudly true: real ingredients, transparent per-100g macros (P/C/F).

headings.usage: Display, headlines, prices, and CTA buttons. Condensed, uppercase, high impact.

body.usage: Body copy, descriptions, nutrition details, labels.

typography.installation_mobile: Load 'Anton_400Regular' + 'HankenGrotesk_400..800' via @expo-google-fonts in app/_layout.tsx; expose names from utils/theme.ts (FONT).
typography.installation_web: Google Fonts <link> in web-panel/index.html: family=Anton & family=Hanken+Grotesk.

usage_rules.backgrounds: Use 'sand' (#F4F1E9) as the main canvas. Use 'ink' (#15140F) for headers, sidebars, bottom nav and high-contrast/featured sections.
usage_rules.text: NEVER pure black. Use 'ink' (#15140F) for primary text, 'muted' (#6B6A5E) for secondary.
usage_rules.ctas: Primary = lime fill + ink text, OR ink fill + lime text. NEVER red/orange as the primary brand color (red/orange only for macros, diet dots and error/warning status).
usage_rules.accent: Lime (#C7F24E) is the single signature accent — active states, the raised 'Build my meal' nav button, key highlights. Use sparingly.

buttons.style: Flat, bold, NO gradients. High contrast.

mobile_bottom_bar.center_button: Raised circular lime button (ink ⚡ icon) for 'Build my meal'.

macro_chips.usage: On every food card show P / C / F chips, color-coded (protein #E2603F, carbs #D69A35, fat #5E97B8).
macro_chips.shape: Small pill, tinted background + colored Anton label.

signature_ux: Goal-first ordering: prominent Fat Loss / Muscle Gain / Maintenance / Beginner selector on home, feeding the AI/diet filter.
Macro chips (P/C/F) on every food card.
Build-your-own-meal: per-100g steppers + sticky bottom summary (live kcal / P / C / F / total price).
Ready-made vs Build-your-own tag on each card.
3-tap checkout with clear pricing and auto-applied offers (BOGO) visible in the bill.

mobile.grid: Single-column scrollable feed; 2-column where dense. Big food imagery.
mobile.safe_area: Respect top/bottom safe areas; sand status-bar area.

web.structure: Fixed ink sidebar (admin) / sticky ink top-nav (kitchen, cashier).
web.dashboard_grid: Bento/stat grid, high density but airy.

mobile_app.notes: Import colors/fonts from utils/theme.ts (FUEL, FONT). Use StyleSheet + Ionicons. Apply Anton to headings/prices/CTAs and Hanken to body.

web_panel.notes: Global App.css holds FUEL tokens as CSS variables; keep all class names + data-testids intact (skin only).

universal_guidelines: NO GRADIENTS: flat, bold colors only.
TEXT HIERARCHY: Anton headings are MASSIVE; Hanken body readable.
ACCENT DISCIPLINE: lime is the only signature accent — use it sparingly for action.
DATA-TESTID: all interactive elements keep their data-testid attributes.

accessibility.contrast: Never pure black. ink (#15140F) on sand (#F4F1E9) passes. ink on lime (#C7F24E) passes for buttons. Light text on ink passes.
